correctness.rationale: Dephase the unit-modulus minor to first row and column equal to one. In the remaining 2-by-2 with entries u,v,w,z, determinant vanishing means (u-1)(z-1)=(v-1)(w-1). If a factor equals zero, a factor from the other side is also zero; the four pairings give a normalized repeated row or column. Otherwise conjugate and divide by the common nonzero product to get uz=vw and then u+z=v+w. Equality of the two root multisets forces a repeated column or row. Fourier proportionality is exactly annihilation of all differences on the opposite index set, giving the stated max-plus-min valuation tests. Rank one instead requires annihilation of every difference pair, exactly t_R+t_C>=k. Fine column residue classes have size p^t, and coarse classes have size p^s. The rank-two union comprises triples within a coarse class but not a fine one, plus triples with a fine pair and third point outside that pair's coarse class. These two disjoint counts give B2; this remains valid when s=t. The E_t count chooses three different children of a residue class; I_{t,s} first chooses the unique close pair at valuation s, then the third point exactly valuation t away from either endpoint. This recovers the full row type partition, including p=2 where E_t=0. For a direct replay of the closed form, write Q_v=N(N^2p^{-2v}-3Np^{-v}+2)/6 and sum (Q_v-Q_{v+1})Q_{k-v}. After extracting N^2/36, the summand is N^2a+9Nb-3N^2a p^{-v}+2N^2a p^{-2v}-3Nb p^v-6Nb p^{-v}, with a=1-p^{-2}, b=1-p^{-1}. The three geometric sums yield precisely (N^2a+9Nb)k-(1+6/p)N^2+(-3+6/p)N+4. Dividing by the squared triple count gives the stated O_p(k/N) remainder at fixed p. For p=2,k=2, every row has (t,s)=(0,1), all B1 and B2 vanish, and all 16 minors are rank three. The included checker.py was inspected, not executed; it independently assesses determinant vanishing by cyclotomic coefficient fibers and rank one by congruences, but it does not separately test the simplified rank-one expression and asymptotic. The exact summation above checks those claims without extrapolating from the finite grid.

value.rationale: A full fixed-row conditional rank distribution for the cyclic prime-power Fourier transform measures loss of interpolation rank, not just whether some choice fails. The rank-one degeneration is rarer than ordinary singularity, and its exact fixed-prime asymptotic exhibits the extra factor of depth on the N^{-2} scale. This is a natural all-depth quantitative invariant beyond the already-known rigidity and prime-square slice.
